sentences.en: Having won the lottery, she went on a shopping spree.
sentences.zh: 中了彩票后，她开始了一连串疯狂购物。

sentences.en: Fadil took his crime spree to a whole new level.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔把他的犯罪狂欢推向了一个全新的高度。

sentences.en: How much did you spend on your last shopping spree?
sentences.zh: 你上一次的疯狂购物花了多少钱？
